thread:
mila: Heads-up team 10: planning a 50m webinar + 15m optional post-session lab. Need final run-of-show, rehearsal schedule, and the A/B headline test for registration.
harry: Proposed headline A (product-led): "Design predictable inference: routing & cost patterns". Headline B (metric-led): "Reduce per-request token cost by 30% while keeping latency". We'll A/B on registration page + LinkedIn creative.
joan: For workshop structure I suggest: 40m main session (talk + demo + Qs) + 10m lab for hands-on deep dive. Lab sign-up should be optional on registration form.
mila: Good. Who can own the lab routing and HubSpot mapping? ops-bot: I can preassign lab groups via Zoom if you capture `lab_preference` on signup. Note: preassign requires matching emails.
harry: Routing plan: use form field `lab_choice` -> HubSpot property -> workflow -> Zoom preassign webhook. We'll also emit `joined_lab:{name}` event for attendance.
joan: Run-of-show draft (50m):
- 00:00-04:00 welcome + poll (pain point)
- 04:00-18:00 patterns talk (mila)
- 18:00-28:00 demo: before/after throughput & cost (harry)
- 28:00-42:00 moderated live Qs + quick poll results
- 42:00-50:00 CTA + trial link + opt-in for post-lab
- 50:00-60:00 optional lab for those who signed up (hosted as breakout)
mila: Rehearsal: full tech run + speaker dry-run 48h prior. Ops-bot, what rehearsal windows do you have?
ops-bot: calendar-helper: Wed 9am PT and Fri 3pm PT available. Webinar platform needs a 15-min test stream 24h prior. Recommend uploading fallback mp4 to CDN and a pre-signed URL.
kelly: Measurement / follow-up plan: HubSpot events to capture: `registered`, `attended_live`, `joined_lab`, `clicked_trial`, `watched_recording`. For A/B we add `headline_arm` to registration UTMs. Report at D+2 and D+7.
harry: Social cadence: teaser 10 days out, speaker reveal + metric tease 7 days, reminder 3 days, 1 day, and 1 hour. Two creative variants: narrative image vs benchmark chart. A/B on LinkedIn, measure CTR -> registration -> trial.
joan: Fallback plan for demos: 1) low-bandwidth recorded video uploaded to CDN, 2) local laptop handoff instructions for presenters: `if stream drop -> stop camera -> share fallback URL in chat -> continue Q&A`. Add fallback slide with CLI snippet & recording link.
mila: Inbound routing logic: if `company_size` > 200 OR `email_domain` matches known enterprise list -> route to AE queue and invite to demo; else enroll in trial nurture. Use micro-survey `primary_pain` to personalize follow-up emails.
kelly: Also set up an alert: spike in `clicked_trial` from a single IP -> flag to demand gen for lead quality check.
harry: Speaker assets needed: 1) 2 benchmark slides, 2) short 2-line bio + headshot, 3) fallback mp4. Due Mon EOD.
mila: I'll draft registration copy with both headline variants and the micro-survey. Everyone review by Friday. Rehearsal locked for Wed 9am PT. Ops-bot please provision breakouts and preassign job.
ops-bot: confirmed  preassign job scheduled; fallback mp4 pre-signed URL available on request. Test stream scheduled 24h prior.
mila: Perfect. Post-webinar plan: send attended -> trial CTA + personalized snippet referencing their `primary_pain`. No-show -> recording + nudge. We'll run headline performance analysis and push winner into next landing page. Thanks team :rocket:
